title: 1 Enoch 77 — The four quarters of the earth, the seven mountains, the seven rivers

paragraphs.text: וקדמיתא קרין לה מדנחא דהיא קדמיתא ותניתא קרין לה ימינא דבה כפיף ידא דכל חי
paragraphs.translit: u-qadmaytāʾ qārēn lāh madnāḥāʾ dī-hīʾ qadmaytāʾ u-tinyāytāʾ qārēn lāh yāminā dī-bāh kāpēp yědāʾ dī-kol ḥay

i18n.en: And the first they call the east, because it is the first; and the second they call the south, because there the hand of every living thing is bowed down.

paragraphs.text: ותליתיתא קרין לה מערבא די תמן עזלין כל נהורי שמיא ותתבון תמן למערב ורביעיתא קרין לה צפונא די בה מסתתרין כל עבדי כרובים ושרפים ובה משכנא דעליא
paragraphs.translit: u-tělītāytāʾ qārēn lāh maʿarbāʾ dī tammān ʿāzělīn kol něhōrē šěmayyāʾ wě-yātbūn tammān lě-maʿărāb u-rěbīʿāytāʾ qārēn lāh ṣěpōnāʾ dī-bāh mistattěrīn kol ʿōbědē kěrūbīm wě-śěrāpīm u-bāh miškěnāʾ dī-ʿillāʾāʾ

i18n.en: And the third they call the west, because there all the lights of heaven are gathered in, and they set there toward the west; and the fourth they call the north, because in it are hidden all the works of the Cherubim and the Seraphim, and there is the dwelling-place of the Most High.

paragraphs.commentary:
**THE NORTH AS DWELLING-PLACE OF THE MOST HIGH — Aramaic-PRIMARY witness (4Q210).** This is one of the most-cosmographically-significant statements in the Astronomical Book: the cosmic-north is the dwelling-place of the Most High. The verse extends the broader Northwest-Semitic + Hebrew Bible north-as-cosmic-mountain tradition that runs through:
- **Ps 48:3** *yarketê ṣāpôn qiryat melek rāḇ* — Mount Zion 'in the recesses of the north' (the Hebrew tradition transferring Mount Ṣapunu's cosmic-mountain attributes onto Zion).
- **Isa 14:13** — the proud claim of the Day-Star-son-of-Dawn to ascend to 'the mount of assembly in the recesses of the north' (yarketê ṣāpôn).
- **Ezek 1:4** — the storm-wind from the north opening the throne-vision.
- **Ugaritic Mount Ṣapunu** — Baʿlu's cosmic-mountain located geographically at Jebel al-Aqra ~50 km north of Ugarit.

The 1 En 77:2 statement makes the north-as-divine-dwelling explicit in the Second-Temple-Jewish apocalyptic-cosmographic register. The Cherubim and Seraphim — the angelic-throne-attendant orders (Ezek 1 + Isa 6) — are located in the cosmic-north as the throne-vision-tradition cosmographic-locale. See central entry `north-as-dwelling-of-most-high-1-enoch-77-2-ps-48-2-zaphon-cross-corpus` and the bidirectional-extension of `mount-sapunu-tsafon-cosmic-mountain-cross-corpus-ugaritic-hebrew-bible`.

paragraphs.text: ወአፍላገ፡ ምድር፡ ሠለስቱ፡ እማንቱ፡ ቀዳማይት፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወካዕብት፡ መንገለ፡ ጾታ፡ ወሣልስት፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaflāga mədr śallastu ʾəmāntu qadāmāyət mangala məśrāq wa-kāʿbət mangala ṣotā wa-śāləst mangala məʿrāb

i18n.en: And the regions of the earth are three: the first toward the east, and the second toward the south, and the third toward the west.

paragraphs.text: וחזית שבעה טורין רברבין מן כל טוריא די בארעא מנהון נפק תליגא ויומיא ועדניא ושניא יחלפון
paragraphs.translit: u-ḥăzēt šibʿāh ṭūrīn rabrěbīn min kol ṭūrayyāʾ dī bě-ʾarʿāʾ minhōn nāpēq taligāʾ wě-yōmayyāʾ wě-ʿiddānayyāʾ wě-šinnayyāʾ yāḥalpōn

i18n.en: And I saw seven great mountains, greater than all the mountains that are upon the earth; from them come forth snow, and the days and the seasons and the years pass by.

paragraphs.commentary:
**The seven mountains — Aramaic-PRIMARY witness (4Q210).** The seven-mountains cosmography here extends the seven-mountains cluster of 1 En 18:6-9 + 24:1-25:7 (the cosmic-mountains-of-precious-stones with the central seventh-mountain as the throne-of-glory site) into the broader cosmographic-treatise of ch 77. The seven-mountains framework is one of the most-systematic apocalyptic-cosmographic extensions of the Northwest-Semitic single-cosmic-mountain tradition (Mount Ṣapunu / Mount Zion / Mount Sinai) into the structured-seven-fold-enumeration register.

See central entry `seven-mountains-of-god-1-enoch-18-24-cosmic-mountain-cluster-extension-cross-corpus` (extended in this Editor pass to include ENO-WOH-77:4-5).

paragraphs.text: ושבעה נהרין רברבין חזית מן כל נהריא קדמיא מנהון רבא דאקרי גיחון ותנינא דקלת ותליתיא פרת
paragraphs.translit: u-šibʿāh nahărīn rabrěbīn ḥăzēt min kol nahărayyāʾ qadmāyāʾ minhōn rabbāʾ dī-ʾiqrē Gēḥōn u-tinyānāʾ Diqlat u-tělītāyāʾ Pěrāt

i18n.en: And I saw seven great rivers, greater than all the rivers — the first of them, the great one called Gihon; and the second, the Tigris; and the third, the Euphrates.

paragraphs.commentary: **The seven rivers — Aramaic-PRIMARY witness (4Q210); cross-corpus to Gen 2:10-14 Eden-rivers.** The seven-rivers framework extends Gen 2:10-14's four Eden-rivers (Pishon, Gihon, Hiddekel/Tigris, Euphrates) into a structured-seven-fold-enumeration. The first three rivers — Gihon, Tigris, Euphrates — are three of the four Gen 2:10-14 Eden-rivers; the fourth Eden-river (Pishon) is absent in the 1 En 77:5 explicit enumeration but is likely among the remaining four rivers named at v. 6 (the Ge'ez of v. 6 has corrupted name-forms — possibly Harmon/Harahot and the Nile). The seven-rivers framework is the cosmographic-apocalyptic extension of the Eden-rivers tradition into the Astronomical-Book cosmographic register.

paragraphs.text: ወካልዓኖሙ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ሐራሞን፡ ወካልዕ፡ ኖሉ፡ ወዘ፡ ይትበሀል፡ ጊሐን፡ ወውስተ፡ ምድረ፡ ግብጽ፡ ይነግሥ፡ ወይነግሥ፡ እምነ፡ መንግሥት፡ ለመንግሥት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kāləʿānomu məʿrāb ḥarāmon wa-kāləʿ Nolu wa-zə yətbahal Gīḥan wa-wəsta mədra Gəbṣ yənaggəś wa-yənaggəś ʾəmənna mangəśt la-mangəśt

i18n.en: And the rest of them go toward the west — the Harmon, and another, the Nile, and that one called the Gihan; and it flows in the land of Egypt, and it goes on from kingdom to kingdom.

paragraphs.text: ወሰብዐ፡ አዕያት፡ ዐበይተ፡ ርእኩ፡ ዐበይተ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ቀዳማይ፡ በባሕር፡ ዘሰሜን፡ ወካልዕ፡ በባሕር፡ ዘምዕራብ፡ ወሣልስ፡ በባሕር፡ ዘይትበሀል፡ ኤሪትራ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-sabʿa ʾaʿyāt ʿabayta rəʾku ʿabayta ʾəmənna kwəlu zawəsta mədr qadāmāyə ba-bāḥr zasamēn wa-kāləʿ ba-bāḥr zaməʿrāb wa-śāləs ba-bāḥr zayətbahal ʾĒritrā

i18n.en: And I saw seven great islands, greater than all that are in the earth: the first in the northern sea, the second in the western sea, and the third in the sea which is called Erythraean.

paragraphs.text: ወዘስብእ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለሐይኮት፡ ስብእ፡ መንበራቶሙ፡ ለዕለታት፡ ወአሐደ፡ መንበር፡ ዐባዪ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ይሰምይ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ ለኪሩቤል፡ ኅዱረ፡ ዘይነብር፡ ዐርእስት፡ ዘይኬልሉ፡ ለመንበራቲሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zasəbʾ ḫolaqomu la-ḥaykot səbʾ manbarātomu la-ʿəlatāt wa-ʾaḥada manbar ʿabāyə lāʿlēhu yəsammə manbaromu la-Kirubēl ḫədura zayənabbər ʿarʾəst zayəkēlalu la-manbarātihu

i18n.en: And the seventh of them, the reckoning of the days has their stations; and one great station upon it is called the dwelling-place of the Cherubim, who abide as chiefs that encompass his stations.

paragraphs.text: ወሰብዐ፡ አዕያት፡ ዐበይተ፡ ርእኩ፡ ዘመሐልዮ፡ ኮኑ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ መንገለ፡ ጾታ፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-sabʿa ʾaʿyāt ʿabayta rəʾku zamaḥalyo konu śallastu mangala məśrāq wa-kəlʾētu mangala ṣotā wa-kəlʾētu mangala məʿrāb

i18n.en: And I saw seven great islands which were apportioned: three toward the east, and two toward the south, and two toward the west.
